value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, Sept 12 to Dec 18, plus Tue/Thu 9:30-12 drop-in at $15 - their site says. Parent & Tot Skating is $4 adult/$2.50 child, though I could not get into their page today for the day. I'll keep watching and text you what I find.
